newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar steady, demand remains at low ebb.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar steady, demand remains at low ebb.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady in a narrow band in a lacklustre local market on Tuesday, dealers in Bombay said.
Consumer demand and offtake by retailers remained at a low ebb amid limited supplies.
"Offerings by the millers remained low, which in turn curtailed arrivals of sugar from mills to the market," one broker said.
"Fresh out-station buying at the mill level has lifted mill delivery prices upwards and curtailed offerings by the millers to the local market," he said.
Meanwhile, ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,465/1,500 rupees per quintal, as was sugar M-30 at 1,485/1,535. However, sugar mill delivery remained firm.
In the mill delivery market, sugar S-30 rose to 1,405/1,415 rupees per quintal from 1,400, while sugar M-30 firmed to 1,425/1,440 rupees from 1,420/1,430.
Traders said they expected sugar prices to move in a narrow range in the coming days.
